name: wired_or
description: Multi-driver bus: link0 is driven by two UserInputs (wired-OR), with a DELAY reading it so the net value has a downstream consumer. The drivers rise and fall one at a time: comp0 high at tick 1 (drivers disagree: link0 high and invalid), comp1 high at tick 4 (both high: valid), comp0 low at tick 7 (invalid again, link0 still high), comp1 low at tick 10 (both low: valid). The DELAY reads the wired-OR value throughout and its own link is never flagged.
